<thought>The search with functional group filter returned no templates. To find a template for sulfonamide formation, we can search using only the bond changes: formation of an S‑N bond (16-7) and breaking of an S‑Cl bond (16-17). This should return templates that encode the forward reaction of a sulfonyl chloride reacting with an amine to give a sulfonamide.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "c1ccc(cc1)S(=O)(=O)N",
    "bonds_formed": ["16-7"],
    "bonds_broken": ["16-17"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
